book.name: LOMU
book.title: Lomu wewenasida luhuwa maya Polokaho je biye

content: Polokaho Isilaelo wewenasiya Jisesida demesa mebomu miluma elibo ga.
Nemoya Kalaestida wewenala minonako, suwa ga lamoko wehe loko wati gago lekoloyo, elilo. Sakokoya Omaimidana weuna oluholimo nilime sahu iyoko ga maya lo libekoloe.
Nemoya Juda wewenasidamuya miluma napa elekaka noe. Edimoya Jisedamu eli elewole amabokumu eke napa-napa lobetokaka noe.
Anuya golotetidanako, iwenele Juda wewenasida dilimitiye loko Omailimo auha nimitibokiya neimone Kalaestitoka omeko minametuboya aha nesa ne loko letine.

Sa-oneboya, edimoki nemokiya Isilaelo wewena minune. Latatele yuhasidaya Omaimidana wewenala wehe loko dilipe eto ibo ne. Sakokoya lawolawolaloti viminabo monoka numukuya emo lamedala maya wehe loko dilipiye, ito loko mutihekaka ga ito Mosesekaho lo hukaibo ga maya lo bidanaki eimola omudalalokago miniki epoka liki minatae loko anuwa dilipeko ga laloya lo molobetaiye.

Sakoya lemo niseko monoka loko monoka leminudawo wewenaya latate Aebalahamule Aesikile Jekopulesida awonipole minune. Kalaestikahoya lemo lupakidana wewena lolo okoko lemo luwawateuti soto pene. Jisesiya muki nesasida ujapa wenipo nenako, Omaiya ne. Yamuya epoka lokogo minatune, Yotokoe.
Omailimoya Isilaelo wewenasitoka sainahena soto pitiye loko libo nesaya woko aha nesa lolo amibo ne. Nenahamu. Isilaelo wewenasikuti soto pebo wewenaya Omailimo dilipe eto ibo wewena lolo i-suwamae.
Ito Aebalahamuda awopilalauti soto pebo wewenaya Omaimidana wewenala lolo i-suwamae. Yamuya Omailimoya Aebalahamudaya sa-loko lo miye:

content.text: Ipaka Aesikida ouvamelalegoya emo ouvamekale lolo ikilae.

content: Sa-itabomidana monawaya sakoya ne: Omailimoya Aebalahamuda omudaloya sa-loko lo moloetaiye: Meleke mako niseko nowideko, menaka Sela maya oluhola etoko lenedekoya alikaya nisekoloe, loko Aesikidamuya lo moloetaibo nenako, Aebalahamuda upauti aha soto pebo wewenaya muki Omaimidana wewenala lolo i-suwamae. Sa-onenako, Omailimo ga lalo lo moloetaibomidana ihilawa jiki soto pi-liki nisebo wewenaya nemo wewenanele yuha lolo niae loko elekaka noiye.
Yago minamiye. Liwekada monawalamuya elilo. Latate Aesikimamoya napa lekoko mena Liwekada maya leko oluhola loweya etaiye.

Aya oluhosiya soto pikiki wehe libo nesahe lahelamibo nesaya owaha lamaiyoko, Omailimoya Liwekada maya sa-loko lo miye: Yatolakahoya unalada elekele oetatiye. Aya oluhosidamuya monoka bukuguya Omailimo alika libo gakiya sa-liki luhuwa ji-minabo maya ne:

content.text: Nemoya unala Jekopudamuya numu helene, ito yatoka Isodamu nelamiye, osele nelokaiye.

content: Loko liboya, Omailimoya ukaukaya wewenasida dilipe eto etuwe loko hapa lo molaiboto maya soto piye. Edimonipo lolo ikaka aibo nesamuye loko minamiye.
Sa-onenako, Omailimo oko moloko noibo nesamuya lemokahoya lekesa jene loko letupe. O'e, sakoya minamiye.
Sa-onenako, yamuya lo libituyo, eli-minalo: Omailimoya Moseseda sa-loko lo menebo maya ne:

content.text: Nemoya wewena makomidana ilime wati etuwe loko aha sa-etubo ne. Wewena makomidana nukane mituwe loko letuboya, aha mitubo ne.

content: Sa-onenako, Omailimoya wewena mako ilimitiboya aya wewenaya abuha moloko woko niseko okakakuya woko lamiye. Omailimoya ukala he lemekaka noibokugoya woko lene loko ele-minune. Yamidana gala mako sa-loko ne:
Peloda maya Omailimo lo mibo ga mako sa-liki monoka bukugu luhuwa ji-minabo maya ne:

content.text: Nemokahoya emotokaya elewoleyane le soto molokoyoko, nemo nuline maya muki numuto namato pou loko wetiye loko ilime sawa jobo maya ne.

content: Sa-onebo maya nenako, Omailimoya wewena makomidana nukane mituwe loko letiboya, aha mitibo we ne loko letune. Ito Pelokidana maya wewena makomidana ukala mamoko he li loetatuwe loko letiboya, aha he li loetatibo ne, loko letune. 4 Eks 9:4 7 Jen 21:12 9 Jen 18:10 12 Jen 25:23 13 Mal 1:2-3 15 Eks 33:19 17 Eks 9:16
Omailimo epalo molokaka nesa ito ukala he lemekaka nesa.

Sa-noideko, maloka wewenalikaya sa-loko lo nimitadawo nehe: Omaimidana monawala maya sakoya nebo maya nenako, emokahoya lemokumuya nenahamuya eliyoko lahelamibo lolo okaka noiye. Omailimoya saina mako lituwe loko letibo nesaya lemo wewenalale anula heko li lokaka nesaya minamiye.

Loko letadawoya, wemageyo, nena abuhakaloti Omaimidana galaya pelesa jitane. Lemoya mika somokidana minudanako, mika somo epawaya minatiboya, aya somo lolo ibo wemidanaya emoya yolamidana oko lolo onetatadawoya dowa lonenako, yamidana oko lolo adawoya wehe lamibo nesa lolo okane loko letibo nehe, sakoya lamekolaiye.

Mika somo lolo okaka wemidana monawala sakoya ne: Eimolaya ata ele-minoko mikalotiya somo lolo okaka noiboya wehe lokogo lolo okaka noiye. Makoko mikalotiya wewenasida sainanipo lolo okaka noiboya, wehe lokomidana lolo okaka noiye. Ito malokaya ja ulasida nesanipo lolo etiboya, wehe lametibomidana ne.

Sa-onenako, Omailimoya somokidana lolo okaiyoko minabo wewena malokaya dokepa usitibo wewena ito sima natabo wewenasidaya auha bituwe loko elekoko, alikaya kohaido helitubo yupekaya kohaido helekatuyo loko esenipo vobetokaka noiye. Omaidaya lihimanipomu epalo molokaka noibo ito elewoleyaki nebomidana monawa dilipekolo sa-okaka noiye.
Ito somokidana oko minatudawo wewena malokaya emo lamedalaloti he lameda loletatuwe loko le lolowa okaka noiye. Sakokoya lilime omudaloka ikoko ukala lemeko lilime lalo nesa okaka noiye.
Sa-ibo nesaya lemo Juda wewenago sa-oletamiye. Juda wewena minamabo ito hetoka wewena ukala bekaka noibo wewenalokakiya sa-olibetokaka noiye.
Yamuya Omaimidana epalauti libo gaya Omaimidana epaloti ga lokaka we Hosaeyada gala sa-loko ne:

content.text: Maloka wewena dilipe molamobolawakiya nemo wewenanele yuha minae loko letuyo. Ito maloka wewena nukane bamobo wewenakiya nukane be-minoe loko letuyo.
Omaimidana wewenala yuha minamae liki li-minabotoya, elewole we Omaimidana wewenalale minae liki litae.

content: Ito Aesayakahoya Isilaelo wewenamuya amowa jeko sa-loko liye:

content.text: Isilaelo wewenalikaya no akekidana iki hutili nidekoya, Omailimoya wewena lasolasisida maya dilipe yowalo molakolaiye.
We napalimoya lemo maya mikau wewena lihimatemuya obi yowanu leletatuwe loko enemane oko leko suwetibo ne.

content: Ito sa-etibokumuya Aesayakaho ga mako koha moloko sa-loko libo ga maya niseko soto piye. Sa-loko luhuwa jibo ne:

content.text: We napalimo okulumauya lowa ulalo wesida ujapa wemamo oluhote malokaya esenipo vametidanako, lemoya Sodomu ebaku ito Gomola ebaku minabo wewenasida diyakau jeko muki heleko ebaletune.

content: Isilaelo wewenaki Omaimidana gala laloki.
Sa-onenako, sa-loko eletudawo ne: Hetoka wewenasiya Omaimidana omudalo wehe letune liki dabuha molamabolawasiya eli elewole abokumuye loko lihimanipo alo suwokaiyoko minae loko lobetaiye.
Ito malokaya Isilaelo wewenasiya Mosesekaho lo hukaibo ga maya ele lekokoya Omaimidana omudaloya lihimate suwokadeko minatune liki elikiki ohu ji-liki waha, li soto molamabo ne.
Saboya nenahamuye. Elewole iki elitabo nesamu sabo ne. Aha yatoka weute moloko sa-etudawolimoya wehe letiye liki sabo ne. Sa-iliki niwayoko, anuloya ehada makolimo lepa ono kohaido hula hula iye.
Sakoya kohaidaibo ehadaya Aesayakaho ohuwa hukoko libo ga maya niseko ulolotiye. Sa-loko luhuwa jibo ne:

content.text: Mudalo, Juda wewenasida luwawanipouya ehadakidana we mako nomolobolimoya lepa ono kohaidakolaiye. Moluda ehada nomolobolimoya kohaidakolaiye. Sa-oneboya, emokumu elewole iki elitabolasiya wiki lalo nesa letune liki ahamuya ewa iki mini-liki wiki lukaha delametibo ne.
